finding.summary: A re-digested payment summary could carry internally inconsistent cleared-stage/provider-event/claim-boundary fields. Digest integrity alone proves that fields were not edited after the digest was computed; it does not prove those fields describe one coherent canonical payment event.

changes: First-cash unlock now requires its single verified provider event to be a one-time order_created event and rejects synthetic/sandbox/fixture/fake/test-style event refs.
claimBoundary.clearedPayment must preserve the canonical three-witness signed-provider/classification/ledger boundary.
claimBoundary.retainedRevenue must preserve the canonical provider-cleared-and-not-reversed boundary.
Hostile tests cover internally re-digested synthetic provider refs, subscription-as-first-cash substitution, mismatched stage refs, and forged claim-boundary semantics.
preservedInvariants: PayPal Sandbox remains economically ineligible and cannot create commercial cleared revenue.
The existing payment-renewal truth ledger/reconciliation pipeline remains canonical; no parallel revenue truth was created.
Exact net USD 450.00 and exactly one verified payment are required.
Customer acceptance remains independently customer-origin and customer-bound.
Five qualified conversations without a paid pilot forces KILL_OR_RETHINK; conversation six is a violation.
